name: fixa
description: Fixa - hackathon build. See README.md and the build plan.

scripts.dev:api: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m uvicorn fixa_api.main:app --reload --reload-dir api --reload-dir packages --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run lint:py && npm run build:app
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff check api packages
scripts.format:py: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff format api packages
